notes:
Sharp PN-HB751 is a 75-inch (190.5cm), 3840x2160 4K LCD large-format signage/meeting-room display from the PN-HB851 (85")/PN-HB751 (75")/PN-HB651 (65") family, with a built-in Android 7.1 SoC digital-signage player (SHARP e-Signage S). It is discontinued (listed "Obsolete" on Sharp's EU site). Desktop/wall-mount panel, VESA 600x400mm 4-point M6 mount — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Power consumption max 320W at 100-240VAC 50/60Hz; weight ~37kg without stand.

Primary source used: Sharp's own global product brochure PDF (PN-HB851_HB751_HB651_BRO_S.pdf), which contains a per-model specifications table and terminal diagrams. Cross-checked against Sharp's US operation manual (PNHxx51_Operation_Manual.pdf, business.sharpusa.com) which includes exact terminal pin-out diagrams (confirms RS-232C In = DE-9, RS-232C Out = DE-9 pinout reached via the supplied 3.5mm-jack conversion cable), and Sharp EU's datasheet/product page (sharp.eu/sharp-pn-hb751), which corroborates the same port counts.

Confidence caveats:
- HDMI grade (2.0) is inferred, not explicitly printed: Sharp's own spec sheet just lists "HDMI x2" with no version number. The AV signal-timing compatibility table confirms 3840x2160@60Hz and 4096x2160@60Hz support (which requires HDMI 2.0-class 18Gbps bandwidth), and the OSD has an "HDMI MODES" MODE1/MODE2 toggle that gates full-bandwidth 4:2:0 vs limited legacy timings — consistent with HDMI 2.0, but not a confirmed "2.0" label from Sharp.
- AC input connector type (mapped to "iec") is inferred from context (detachable "AC power cord" accessory plugging into an "AC input terminal", with a cable-clamp strain relief) — no manufacturer diagram/photo explicitly names the inlet as IEC C13/C14.
- USB port labeling: Sharp's spec table states 3 total USB ports (2x USB 3.0-compliant + 1x USB 2.0-compliant, all Type-A), but does not give individual port numbers/labels, so "USB (3.0) 1/2" and "USB (2.0)" names here are generic, not printed silkscreen labels.

Not modeled as ports (out of scope for AV signal/power I/O): 2x external Wi-Fi antenna (SMA-style) terminals for the built-in IEEE802.11ac/n/a/g/b + Bluetooth 4.1 radio; a microSD card slot (media playback, not a cable-routed signal path); and a Mini-OPS-style internal expansion slot (12V/2.5A) for optional add-on boards (PN-ZB03H HDBaseT 2.0 receiver board or PN-ZB03W wireless-collaboration board), which are separate optional accessories rather than standard I/O on the base unit.

ports.name: DisplayPort Out
ports.note: Used to daisy-chain up to 4 monitors; output is disabled when the unit is off/standby and does not pass HDR.

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Line/headphone output; not controllable from the on-screen audio menu.

ports.name: RS-232C In
ports.note: Physically a standard DE-9 (D-sub 9-pin) female connector on the unit.

ports.name: RS-232C Out
ports.note: Physically a 3.5mm mini stereo jack on the unit; Sharp ships a bundled RS-232C conversion cable (3.5mm-to-DE-9) to present it as a standard RS232 port. No distinct connector id exists for this jack variant in the taxonomy, so it is mapped to rs232.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Connector shell type inferred (standard detachable IEC C13/C14 inlet, cable-clamp retained); the exact IEC variant is not explicitly stated/photographed in the documentation reviewed.
